description: For a currency pair, explain documented tokenised deposit networks and payment instruments, their evidence status, access constraints and unknowns. A currency match is only a lead: it never confirms participating banks, executable FX liquidity, local payout, fees or end-to-end timing. Investment assets are excluded as payment routes. Free returns a concise masked preview; a paid key for this pair unlocks source-linked detail. No execution or advice.

access_key.description: Optional router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.
